title: Export to file and share, with cache cleanup and a narrowed FileProvider
findings_note: TrackerRepository.kt:124-136 (exports written to cacheDir and never deleted); res/xml/file_paths.xml (whole cache dir and external files exposed); MainScreen.kt:244-246 (share sheet only)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the CSV format (S17), the import flow (S44), and encrypting exports (a later item).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- Export is share-sheet only. A user who wants "save a backup to Downloads or Drive" depends on the share targets.
- Exported files hold the user's whole history and are left in the app cache forever.
- `file_paths.xml` exposes the entire cache directory and the external files dir through the `FileProvider`, which is wider than needed.
- Disk writes happen on the main thread today (S06 fixes that in the repository; this slice must not reintroduce it).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM, in `ExportCacheTest`, using a JUnit `TemporaryFolder`:
- `clear deletes every file in the exports directory and keeps the directory`
- `clear on a missing directory does nothing`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Repository: replace `exportCsv(context)` and `exportBackup(context)` (which return cache `File`s) with `suspend fun backupJson(): String` and `suspend fun entriesCsv(): String` (using S17's `CsvExport.build`). They do no file IO.
2. `ExportCache`: `fun exportsDir(context): File = File(context.cacheDir, "exports").apply { mkdirs() }` and `fun clear(dir: File)` which deletes the files inside it. Call `clear` from `ConsecutorApp.onCreate` on `Dispatchers.IO`, and before writing any new share file.
3. ViewModel: `exportTo(context, uri, kind)` runs on `Dispatchers.IO` and writes with `context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri, "wt")?.use { it.write(text.toByteArray()) }`, reporting success or failure through the message flow. `share(context, kind)` writes to `exportsDir`, builds the `FileProvider` URI and starts the chooser, as `shareFile` does today.
4. Settings UI: each export card (CSV and backup) gets a primary "Save to file…" button and a secondary "Share…" text button. Use `rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json"))` for the backup and `CreateDocument("text/csv")` for the CSV. Launch with the default names `consecutor-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json` and `consecutor-entries-YYYY-MM-DD.csv` (date from the ViewModel's `today`).
5. Add one line of copy on each export card: "Exports are unencrypted and contain your full history. Store them somewhere private."
6. `file_paths.xml` becomes just `<cache-path name="exports" path="exports/" />`. Remove the `external-files-path` entry after checking with `rg` that nothing writes there.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` passes.
- Manual: save a backup to Downloads and open the file. Share a CSV to another app. After restarting the app, `adb shell run-as com.squalor.consecutor ls cache/exports` shows no leftover files (debug build).
- Cancelling the save dialog does nothing and shows no error.
